 by Bob Maplewood at 2:30am on Sun 15th November 2026   (last updated 5:30pm 16/11/2026 )
 Estonia enter A Le Coq Arena for their final match in the Nations League C group phase. They are up against Bulgaria this coming Monday, with both looking to collect a few extra points. It finished all square on when Estonia last faced Bulgaria. With both denying to back down, the scoreboard said 0-0 in the end. The best betting odds on a draw at full-time with the bookies are at 11/5 .
 Estonia enter their upcoming game placed as number 120 in the FIFA world ranking. There is a bit of a gap to opponents Bulgaria, who enter the game ranked number 91 in the world. 
 This is the final round of the group stage with Estonia on nine as number two and Bulgaria on four as number three. 
 Estonia are not a high scoring team these days, as they only found the back of the net six times in the last ten outings. That is an average of just 0.6 goals per game, as they conceded nine goals. They managed five clean sheets in these matches. 
 Bulgaria travel to their next Nations League C match, averaging a lowly 0.6 goals per game in their last ten matches. They scored a disappointing total of six goals, while also conceding 16 goals. That amounts to an average of 1.6 per game, in which they kept their opponents from scoring five times. 
 Estonia vs Bulgaria Prediction
 Estonia Form
 Estonia are unbeaten in their last three matches, first beating Luxembourg 1-0, and then drawing 0-0 with Iceland. They were back as winners when they defeated Luxembourg 0-1. Estonia won half of their previous six internationals, while also drawing three. They lost zero, while they scored four and conceded one goals.
 Bulgaria Form 
 In their previous three outings, Bulgaria lost 3-0 against Iceland, beat Luxembourg 0-2 and lost 0-5 against Iceland. Bulgaria claimed just one win from the last six internationals. These also drew two and lost three games, as they were outscored by 12 goals to five. 
 Bulgaria could find it tough to break down the defensive barriers put up by Estonia at A Le Coq Arena on Monday. The home side doesn't score much themselves, though, and we aim for the under 2.5 goals betting market. 
 Estonia didn't lose any of their previous 7 matches.
